## Checklist

- [ ] The change was discussed in an issue (required for features and large changes)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:i18n`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] New UI text exists in both `en.json` and `pt-br.json`
- [ ] Tests added or updated (server rules, permissions and leaks need a test)
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin))
- [ ] No code, assets or formats copied from proprietary tools
